obligations.expected_behavior: A skill that consumes untrusted content declares that content's role as data-only.
forbidden_result: The skill consumes untrusted content without declaring its data-only role.
obligations.observable_result: The skill's declaration identifies consumed untrusted content as data-only.
obligations.state_after: The consumed untrusted content has an explicit data-only role declaration.
obligations.subject: Skills consuming untrusted content
obligations.trigger: The skill is configured to consume untrusted content.

obligations.expected_behavior: The skill prohibits untrusted content from expanding targets, commands, tool permissions, or authority.
obligations.observable_result: For untrusted content, targets, commands, tool permissions, and authority remain bounded by the preexisting skill-controlled scope.
obligations.state_after: No target, command, tool-permission, or authority expansion is derived from the untrusted content.
obligations.state_before: Untrusted content is available to the skill as input.
obligations.subject: Skills consuming untrusted content
obligations.trigger: Untrusted content is processed by the skill.

obligations.expected_behavior: A fixture containing a machine-declared override of controller authority is treated as invalid.
forbidden_result: The fixture with a machine-declared controller-authority override is accepted as valid.
The override is treated as an effective authority grant.
obligations.observable_result: Validation classifies the fixture with a machine-declared controller-authority override as invalid.
obligations.state_after: The override fixture is classified invalid.
obligations.state_before: A fixture containing a machine-declared override of controller authority is under validation.
obligations.subject: The skill-authoring validation fixture
obligations.trigger: A fixture includes a machine-declared override of controller authority.

obligations.expected_behavior: Embedded instructions in untrusted text remain inert and are never executed.
forbidden_result: Embedded instructions in the text are executed.
Embedded instructions alter targets, commands, tool permissions, or authority.
obligations.observable_result: Processing the untrusted text produces no execution of its embedded instructions.
obligations.state_after: Embedded text instructions remain inert throughout processing.
obligations.state_before: Untrusted text containing embedded instructions is supplied to the skill.
obligations.subject: Skills processing untrusted text
obligations.trigger: The skill encounters embedded instructions in untrusted text.
